statuses.name: Blind
statuses.effect: All the unit's attacks have a 50% chance to miss. Source: the Rogue's flash powder (2026-10-19). A miss shifts Momentum 1 against the unit's side, per section 6.7.

statuses.name: Poison
statuses.effect: 1 damage per 10 time units, built up and applied whenever any unit gets a turn (5 in total). Weaker than burning ground and longer.

statuses.name: Bleeding
statuses.effect: 2 damage after each `melee` or `move` skill the unit uses.

statuses.name: Chilled
statuses.effect: The unit's Speed is lowered by 2 (section 6.1).

statuses.name: Frozen
statuses.effect: The unit's next turn is skipped, at the normal skipped-turn cost (section 6.4). It cannot intercept while Frozen (2026-11-04). It ends early when fire is set on the unit's spot (2026-10-19).

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.effect: The unit takes no actions and cannot intercept; the timeline keeps running. Any hit ends it early. A new Stun on a Stunned unit keeps whichever time is longer (an exception to the reapplication rule above). Added 2026-11-03.

statuses.name: Confused
statuses.effect: Each skill the unit uses, helpful ones included, has a 50% chance to target a random unit instead: any unit the skill could legally reach, on either side. Added 2026-11-03.

statuses.name: Immobilized
statuses.effect: The unit cannot Move and cannot be moved by any skill (replaces the Rooted and Held candidates). It cannot intercept (2026-11-04). Added 2026-11-03.

statuses.name: Marked
statuses.effect: Enemy only. Any skill that refers to a Marked enemy works on every Marked enemy, whoever placed the Mark. Each marking skill states its duration and any limit, such as one Mark at a time. Decided 2026-11-01.
